interpretation: Small targeted curriculum repair produced a real but modest dev gain while some previously passing competencies regressed under the fresh linear head. This is evidence of a partially useful but fragile representation, not a signal to keep expanding tiny repair data indefinitely.
builder_rule: When a frozen representation probe improves only modestly after targeted repair and errors move between competencies, freeze the current benchmark and test representation growth next. Do not immediately author another repair shard or unfreeze a large backbone on a tiny development-driven curriculum.

next_experiment.action: resume public N0 MLM from step 1000 to step 2500, then train a fresh frozen readiness head on the unchanged seed+coverage+repair curriculum
next_experiment.purpose: separate backbone representation growth from curriculum expansion
